what: In the one-screen Section at the end of the page, a cone of light closes and the lights go out. The dark walls on both sides (half the Section width each) are opened ±32° around the top center vertex, then close to 0° while the Section passes through the screen (cover) from 30% to 45%, and over the same range a dark veil covers from opacity 0 to 1. Then from 45% to 50% the last line resolves from 5px blur and transparent. It is tied straight to the scroll value, so scrolling back up opens it again.

options.angle: Initial opening angle (deg), default 32 — first wall +, second wall −
options.from: Start of closing — section cover %, default 30
options.to: Fully closed · just fully covered — cover %, default 45
options.line-to: Last line fully formed — cover %, default 50
options.blur: Starting blur of the last line (px), default 5
options.[data-fx-part=wall]: Two dark walls — the first pivots on its top-right corner, the second on its top-left corner
options.[data-fx-part=line]: (Optional) A line that settles in after everything fades out

use:
…Left wall…
…Right wall…

The last line

from.where: index.html .ny-end__room (end scene — two walls ±32° → 0° · dark curtain cover 30% → 45%, the line “Not ready to go back yet” 45% → 50% blur 5px). The original is a Studio scroll animation

note: Wall, curtain and line are stacked at the same height as the section (one screen), which matches each measuring its own span as in the original. The wall art is painted by the user (the original is a dark panel with rough grain edges)
